<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { DnDProvider, type AutoAnimation, type DropAnimation, type LayoutAnimation } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import AnimLane from './AnimLane.vue';
import { tiltDrop, tiltMove } from './tilt';

const SLOW = { duration: 700, easing: 'ease-in-out' };

// One shape per lane, for all three options: sorting, the drop, and changes no drag made.
const lanes: { label: string; animation: LayoutAnimation; dropAnimation: DropAnimation; animateChanges: AutoAnimation }[] = [
  { label: 'true', animation: true, dropAnimation: true, animateChanges: true },
  { label: 'false', animation: false, dropAnimation: false, animateChanges: false },
  { label: '{ duration: 700 }', animation: SLOW, dropAnimation: SLOW, animateChanges: SLOW },
  // `animateChanges` takes no function itself: its parts (`move`, `enter`, `leave`) do.
  { label: 'ƒ tilt', animation: tiltMove, dropAnimation: tiltDrop, animateChanges: { move: tiltMove } },
];

const letters = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'];
const rows = ref(lanes.map(() => letters.map((id, i) => ({ id, hue: 150 + i * 40 }))));

/** The same new order in every lane (Fisher–Yates: every order as likely): `animateChanges` plays it four ways. */
const shuffle = () => {
  const order = [...letters];
  for (let i = order.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [order[i], order[j]] = [order[j]!, order[i]!];
  }
  rows.value = rows.value.map((lane) => order.map((id) => lane.find((row) => row.id === id)!));
};
</script>

<template>
  <div class="demo">
    <code><DnDProvider :animation="shape" :drop-animation="shape" :animate-changes="shape"></code>
    <div class="lanes">
      <!-- A provider per lane: each one has its own animations. -->
      <DnDProvider
        v-for="(lane, index) in lanes"
        :key="lane.label"
        :animation="lane.animation"
        :drop-animation="lane.dropAnimation"
        :animate-changes="lane.animateChanges"
      >
        <AnimLane v-model="rows[index]!" :label="lane.label" />
      </DnDProvider>
    </div>
    <button type="button" @click="shuffle">Shuffle all</button>
  </div>
</template>

import type { DropAnimation, LayoutAnimation, Rect } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

const SPRING = 'cubic-bezier(.3, 1.5, .5, 1)';

/** A row slides to its new place tilted, and springs straight. */
export const tiltMove: LayoutAnimation = ({ element, from, to, reducedMotion }) => {
  if (reducedMotion) return;
  // Animate `translate` from the old place to none: it composes with the row's own transforms.
  return element.animate(
    [
      { translate: `${from.left - to.left}px ${from.top - to.top}px`, rotate: '-5deg' },
      { translate: '0 0', rotate: '0deg' },
    ],
    { duration: 480, easing: SPRING },
  );
};

const place = (rect: Rect, angle: number): Keyframe => ({
  transform: `translate3d(${rect.left}px, ${rect.top}px, 0) rotate(${angle}deg)`,
  transformOrigin: '50% 50%',
  width: `${rect.width}px`,
  height: `${rect.height}px`,
});

/** The overlay swings onto its slot; with no slot to land on, it fades out. */
export const tiltDrop: DropAnimation = ({ overlay, from, to, reducedMotion }) => {
  if (reducedMotion) return;
  if (!to) return overlay.animate([{ opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration: 200, fill: 'forwards' });
  return overlay.animate([place(from, 8), place(to, 0)], { duration: 520, easing: SPRING, fill: 'forwards' });
};
